# Asset Instructions

The external assets (audio and images) initially used in this project were protected against hotlinking, causing 403/404 errors. 

To fix this, the code has been updated to look for local files in the `public/sounds` directory.

## Required Audio Files

Please download your preferred sound effects (mp3) and place them in `public/sounds/` with the following names:

- `ambient-normal.mp3`: Standard background music (Synthwave recommended).
- `ambient-upside-down.mp3`: Creepy/Horror background ambience.
- `hover.mp3`: Short sci-fi blip for hover effects.
- `click.mp3`: Mechanical or sci-fi click sound.
- `transition.mp3`: A "whoosh" or "thud" sound for the dimension switch.

**Recommended Sources (Free/CC0):**
- [Mixkit Sci-Fi](https://mixkit.co/free-sound-effects/sci-fi/)
- [Freesound.org](https://freesound.org/)
